rows.proposal: Test gap. Public steps: with an autonomy policy that permits automatic rework, adopt a plan and run a Task whose Run fails (or whose check fails); the Workflow's automaticRequeue writes the TaskRequeue (business/workflow/workflow.ts:1528-1548); read the work line (or node detail) before the next claim. Expect attention 'failed' with reason.params {autoCount, cap} (for check_incomplete, 'blocked'/round_inconclusive with the same params). Add to tests/work-graph/S2C-lines-attention.test.ts, reusing the failing-run/automatic-requeue drive in tests/scenarios/A11-no-progress.test.ts.
